📺 The Neighborhood (2018–Present)

The Neighborhood follows Dave Johnson, a friendly and optimistic man who moves with his wife, Gemma, and their young son from Michigan to a predominantly Black neighborhood in Los Angeles. Determined to make friends with everyone, Dave quickly discovers that his outgoing personality doesn’t always impress his new neighbor, Calvin Butler, a proud and outspoken family man who isn’t interested in welcoming outsiders. Despite their differences, the two families gradually develop an unexpected friendship while navigating hilarious misunderstandings, cultural differences, family challenges, and everyday neighborhood drama. As their relationships grow, they discover that friendship can overcome even the biggest differences. Combining heartwarming family moments, clever humor, and entertaining situations, the series explores community, friendship, acceptance, and the importance of understanding one another.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Family • Sitcom

⭐ IMDb: 6.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: ~22 minutes per episode • 8 seasons

🎥 Creator: Jim Reynolds

🏆 Recognition: Starring Cedric the Entertainer, Max Greenfield, Tichina Arnold, and Beth Behrs, the series became a popular CBS sitcom known for its comedic chemistry, family-centered storytelling, and humorous exploration of cultural differences.

📺 Where to Watch: Paramount+ • CBS • Amazon Prime Video • Apple TV (digital purchase). Availability varies by region.
